description: Upstream firmware sources WebFlash imports raw .bin assets from. WebFlash owns signing, sidecar generation, manifest generation, and deployment. The source repo only publishes raw release assets — its own manifest.json (if any) is consumed as build-info metadata, never as the production manifest.

delisted_sources.delisted_reason: Delisted 2026-07-06 by WF-H1-REIMPORT-CLEAN-001 step W1 (decision R-D1, REBUILD-CLEAN-CREDENTIALS-001): the served v1.0.0-preview binary was built before the upstream credential gate (SEC-ESP-BUILD-GATES-001, esphome-public PR #779) and carries the shared default credentials described in docs/security/advisory-default-credentials-DRAFT.md. The config cannot be rebuilt on the sanctioned upstream release pipeline (the fan-token guardrail keeps fan rows out of upstream config/webflash-builds.json), so the source is delisted instead of re-imported. It was an Advanced-install-only, acknowledgement-gated preview; never stable, recommended, default, or buyable. Re-listing requires a fresh sources.json entry backed by a post-gate upstream release and a new upstream eligibility decision.
